content_visible_in_ui: Course full name, short name, sections, activities and course content are visible through the Moodle course interface.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Full name, short name, category, visibility, dates, ID number and completion settings are available in course settings.
fields_returned_by_rest: id, shortname and fullname returned successfully. idnumber, visible and enablecompletion returned as null for api_mvp.
database_tables_inspected: Not inspected; the required information was obtained through the configured Moodle REST API.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: REST API using field=shortname and values MVP-SW and MVP-DATA.
permissions_required: Authorised web-service user and access to core_course_get_courses_by_field. Additional course permissions are needed for restricted metadata.
limitations: The current service user receives public identity fields but some administrative metadata is restricted or null.

content_visible_in_ui: Section headings and the activities contained in each section are visible on the Moodle course page.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Section name, order, visibility and summary can be inspected through the course interface and section settings.
fields_returned_by_rest: component, hiddenbynumsections, id, itemid, modules, name, section, summary, summaryformat, uservisible, visible
database_tables_inspected: Not inspected; the required information was obtained through the configured Moodle REST API.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: REST API using core_course_get_contents with course IDs 2 and 3.
permissions_required: Authorised web-service user, access to core_course_get_contents and course-level moodle/course:view capability.
limitations: Only sections visible to the service user are returned. The response describes structure but is not a complete database record.

content_visible_in_ui: Activity and resource titles, types and their placement inside course sections are visible on the course page.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Module name, activity type, visibility, completion settings and activity URL can be inspected through Moodle.
fields_returned_by_rest: activitybadge, afterlink, branded, candisplay, completion, completiondata, contents, contentsinfo, contextid, customdata, dates, description, downloadcontent, groupmode, id, indent, instance, modicon, modname, modplural, name, noviewlink, onclick, purpose, url, uservisible, visible, visibleoncoursepage
database_tables_inspected: Not inspected; the required information was obtained through the configured Moodle REST API.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Read the modules arrays returned inside each section by core_course_get_contents.
permissions_required: Authorised web-service user, course access and the relevant module-view capabilities such as mod/page:view and mod/quiz:view.
limitations: The response provides module structure and metadata, but it may not include complete Page body text, Quiz questions or competency links.

content_visible_in_ui: The Page title, introduction and formatted learning content are visible through the Moodle Page interface.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Page name, description, availability, completion conditions, competencies and display settings are visible through Page settings.
fields_returned_by_rest: content, contentfiles, contentformat, course, coursemodule, display, displayoptions, enableaitools, enabledaiactions, groupingid, groupmode, id, intro, introfiles, introformat, lang, legacyfiles, legacyfileslast, name, revision, section, timemodified, visible
database_tables_inspected: Not inspected; the required information was obtained through the configured Moodle REST API.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Use mod_page_get_pages_by_courses for course IDs 2 and 3. Extract the name, intro and content fields, then convert the HTML content to normalized plain text for BM25 and LLM processing.
permissions_required: Authorised web-service user, function mod_page_get_pages_by_courses enabled in the service, course access and the mod/page:view capability.
limitations: The content field may contain HTML, embedded media references and Moodle-specific markup that must be cleaned before text retrieval. Activity competency links are not included in this response.

content_visible_in_ui: Quiz title, introduction, availability, attempt controls, grading configuration and quiz questions are visible through the Moodle Quiz interface.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Quiz name, description, time limit, attempts allowed, grade, question marks, review settings, completion conditions and competency associations are visible in Quiz settings.
fields_returned_by_rest: allowofflineattempts, attemptonlast, attempts, autosaveperiod, browsersecurity, canredoquestions, completionattemptsexhausted, completionpass, course, coursemodule, decimalpoints, delay1, delay2, enableaitools, enabledaiactions, graceperiod, grade, grademethod, groupingid, groupmode, hasfeedback, hasquestions, id, intro, introfiles, introformat, lang, name, navmethod, overduehandling, preferredbehaviour, questiondecimalpoints, questionsperpage, reviewattempt, reviewcorrectness, reviewgeneralfeedback, reviewmarks, reviewmaxmarks, reviewoverallfeedback, reviewrightanswer, reviewspecificfeedback, section, showblocks, showuserpicture, sumgrades, timeclose, timelimit, timeopen, visible
database_tables_inspected: Not inspected; the required information was obtained through the configured Moodle REST API.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Use mod_quiz_get_quizzes_by_courses for Quiz metadata. Use a separate database extraction for individual question names, question text, answers and feedback.
permissions_required: Authorised web-service user, the function mod_quiz_get_quizzes_by_courses enabled in the service, course access and mod/quiz:view.
limitations: The REST response returns Quiz configuration and indicates whether questions exist, but it does not return individual question text or answers. The hasquestions field is a presence indicator, not a question count.

content_visible_in_ui: Question name, question text, answer choices, grades and feedback are visible through the Moodle Quiz and Question-bank interfaces.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Question type, default mark, answer grading fractions, feedback, question order and Quiz placement are visible through question editing and Quiz configuration pages.
rest_function_tested: mod_quiz_get_quizzes_by_courses; no configured REST function returned individual question text
fields_returned_by_rest: Quiz-level metadata only, including hasquestions. Individual question names, texts and answers were not returned.
database_tables_inspected: m_quiz, m_quiz_slots, m_question_references, m_question_versions, m_question_bank_entries, m_question, m_question_answers
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Use a read-only PostgreSQL query joining Quiz slots to question references, versioned question-bank entries, questions and answers. Resolve the selected or latest applicable question version, then export question text, answers, grading fractions and feedback to CSV.
permissions_required: Read-only access to the local Moodle PostgreSQL database. No additional Moodle REST capability was sufficient for extracting individual question text with the currently configured service.
limitations: The SQL query depends on the Moodle 5.2 database schema and the installation table prefix. Question and answer text may contain HTML that must be normalized before BM25 or LLM processing. Direct database access should remain read-only.

content_visible_in_ui: The framework name, description, scale, taxonomy and hierarchical competency tree are visible in Site administration under Competency frameworks.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Framework short name, ID number, description, visibility, scale, taxonomy and context are available through framework settings.
rest_function_tested: No competency-framework REST function was configured in the MVP service.
fields_returned_by_rest: Not returned by the five configured REST functions.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Use a read-only PostgreSQL query filtered by framework ID number UTC_GI_MVP_2026.
permissions_required: Administrator access for the Moodle UI or read-only access to the local Moodle PostgreSQL database.
limitations: The extraction is database-schema dependent. Description and scale configuration fields may contain HTML or serialized configuration data.

content_visible_in_ui: Competency names, descriptions, identifiers, hierarchy and parent-child relationships are visible in the framework competency tree.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Short name, ID number, description, parent competency, path, scale, rule outcome and ordering can be inspected through Moodle and the database.
rest_function_tested: No individual-competency REST function was configured in the MVP service.
fields_returned_by_rest: Not returned by the five configured REST functions.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Join m_competency with m_competency_framework and recursively interpret parentid and path. Filter by UTC_GI_MVP_2026 and export all 13 competencies.
permissions_required: Administrator access for competency management or read-only access to the local Moodle PostgreSQL database.
limitations: Competency descriptions may contain HTML. Parent-child structure must be reconstructed from parentid, path and sortorder.

content_visible_in_ui: Competencies assigned to each course are visible from the course Competencies page.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Competency name, identifier, description, course-completion behaviour and ordering are visible on the course competency page.
rest_function_tested: No course-competency-link REST function was configured in the MVP service.
fields_returned_by_rest: The configured course REST functions did not return course competency links.
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Join m_competency_coursecomp to the course and competency tables. Filter courses MVP-SW and MVP-DATA and framework UTC_GI_MVP_2026.
permissions_required: Permission to view course competencies in Moodle or read-only access to the local PostgreSQL database.
limitations: The link table records assigned competencies and rule outcomes but does not contain the learning-resource text used to justify the association.

content_visible_in_ui: Competencies attached to a Page or Quiz are visible in the activity settings and from the course competency interface.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Activity name, activity type, associated competency and the action performed upon activity completion are visible through Moodle settings.
rest_function_tested: core_course_get_contents, mod_page_get_pages_by_courses and mod_quiz_get_quizzes_by_courses were tested, but none returned the activity-competency associations.
fields_returned_by_rest: Course-module and activity metadata were returned, but competency IDs attached to those activities were not returned.
database_tables_inspected: m_competency_modulecomp, m_course_modules, m_modules, m_course, m_competency, m_competency_framework, m_page, m_quiz
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Join m_competency_modulecomp to course modules, module types, Pages, Quizzes and competencies. Export the 20 manually configured links and compare them with data/gold/manual_moodle_links.csv.
permissions_required: Permission to edit or view activity competency settings in Moodle, or read-only access to the local PostgreSQL database.
limitations: The table records that an association exists but does not store a textual explanation or evidence passage. The project therefore maintains a separate manual gold-standard CSV containing the justification.

content_visible_in_ui: Activity completion requirements and completion status are visible on course pages, activity pages and completion reports.
metadata_visible_in_ui: Completion method, required activity view, required grade, passing-grade condition, expected completion date and user completion state can be inspected through activity settings and completion reports.
fields_returned_by_rest: completion, completiondata and related course-module metadata. Availability of user completiondata depends on the service user's permissions and context.
database_tables_inspected: m_course, m_course_modules, m_modules, m_course_modules_completion, m_user, m_page, m_quiz, m_forum
exact_extraction_method_chosen: Use core_course_get_contents for activity-level completion metadata. Use a read-only PostgreSQL query joining course modules with m_course_modules_completion and m_user to obtain configured completion rules and stored user completion states.
permissions_required: Course access and permission to view the relevant activities for REST metadata. Read-only PostgreSQL access is required for complete inspection of stored user-completion records.
limitations: Completion records are user-dependent and may not exist until a learner interacts with an activity. Activity completion is different from overall course completion. Announcement forums intentionally have no completion rule.
